CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".workflow_definitions (
    workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
    record JSONB NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".workflow_runs (
    run_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
    workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    record JSONB NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_runs_active ON "honua".workflow_runs (created_at, run_id) WHERE active
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_runs_history ON "honua".workflow_runs (workflow_id, created_at DESC, run_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_runs_expiry ON "honua".workflow_runs (expires_at) WHERE NOT active

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".workflow_schedule_cursors (
    workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY,
    completed_ticks BIGINT,
    pending_ticks BIGINT
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".workflow_trigger_cursors (
    workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    cursor_kind TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    marker TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal BYTEA NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (workflow_id, cursor_kind)
)
